---
id: patch-commit
title: "pnpm patch-commit <path>"
---

Generate a patch out of a directory and save it (inspired by a similar command in Yarn).

This command will compare the changes from `path` to the package it was supposed to patch, generate a patch file, save the patch file to `patchesDir` (which can be customized by the `--patches-dir` option), and add an entry to [`patchedDependencies`].

Usage:

```sh
pnpm patch-commit <path>
```

* `path` is the path to a modified copy of the patch target package, usually the directory generated by [`pnpm patch`](./patch). It can also be a package name or specifier. If several edit directories match it, the command fails with `ERR_PNPM_AMBIGUOUS_PATCH_TARGET`.

After recording the patch, pnpm runs an install to apply it.

## Options

### --patches-dir &lt;patchesDir>

The generated patch file will be saved to this directory. By default, patches are saved to the `patches` directory in the root of the project.

[`patchedDependencies`]: ./patch.md#patcheddependencies
